summary: Flashlight polling is using IsInputKeyDown edge detection for the toggle key and controller capture key, with polling capped at 60 Hz so normal Xbox B presses are not missed. The default toggle remains Unreal Gamepad_FaceButton_Right, which maps to Xbox B. The previous failure mode was coarse polling at the idle period, where a normal short button press could occur entirely between polls and never be observed.
work_completed: Verified examples/flashlight/run.py has a helper around player_controller.IsInputKeyDown(Key=key).
Verified --toggle-key uses previous/current key-down edge detection so a held button toggles once per press instead of every poll.
Verified controller pose capture also uses the same edge detection while Enter capture remains intact.
Ran syntax verification: python -m py_compile examples/flashlight/run.py.
